en: Vintage real-photo postcard showing three people posed on a terrace or balcony: a seated man in a wicker chair wearing a suit, a younger man in a military-style uniform standing behind him with arms crossed, and a woman in a dark dress standing to the side. There is a railing with trees visible beyond it and a small table with potted plants against the wall. The reverse side has the typical divided-back layout for address and message, plus handwritten numbers and notes in pencil.
